name: eventos
description: EventOS — full-stack app (Express + TypeScript backend, Next.js + React frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.ci:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.lint: eslint server --max-warnings 0 && npm --prefix client run lint
